title: Red Cliffs: The Fire That Split an Empire in Three
summary: Tells how, in the winter of two hundred and eight, Cao Cao's huge northern army and fleet on the Yangtze were destroyed at Red Cliffs by the far smaller allied forces of Sun Quan and Liu Bei, using Huang Gai's feigned surrender and fire ships driven by the wind. The episode covers Zhou Yu's command, the disease that wore down the northern troops, the retreat along the Huarong road, and how this defeat ended any hope of reuniting the Han and led to the age of the Three Kingdoms.
